verdict.rationale: Kong publishes a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its own APIs (kong-docs-9) and Insomnia explicitly supports importing/exporting OpenAPI specs, including CLI export via `inso export spec` for CI use (kong-docs-12, kong-docs-26, kong-docs-31), giving AI-native users a clear machine-readable spec download path. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the OpenAPI directory files are complete/versioned, and no direct third-party confirmation of the export workflow's reliability.
